scripts.build:all: npm run build:flutter && npm run build
scripts.install: cd src && bun install && cd ../flutter/desktop && flutter pub get
scripts.install:deps: bun install && cd flutter/desktop && flutter pub get && cd src-tauri && cargo fetch
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:flutter
scripts.lint: cd src && bun run lint && cd ../src-tauri && cargo clippy -- -D warnings
scripts.lint:fix: cd src && bun run lint:fix && cd ../src-tauri && cargo clippy --fix -- -D warnings
scripts.format: cd src && bun run format && cd ../src-tauri && cargo fmt
scripts.format:check: cd src && bun run format:check && cd ../src-tauri && cargo fmt --check
scripts.clean: cd src-tauri && cargo clean && cd ../flutter/desktop && flutter clean && rm -rf node_modules
